export_components.name: Single Patient Export
export_components.description: Maximus allows a user to export electronic health information (EHI) for a single patient at any time without developer assistance.

export_components.name: Multi-Patient Export
export_components.description: Maximus can export all the data for a patient population in standardized format.

export_components.name: CCD/C-CDA Documents
export_components.description: Bulk export of HL7 CCDA xml files complying to USCDI v1 requirements.
standards_referenced: HL7 CDA Release 2: IHE Health Story Consolidation DSTU R1.1 (July 2012)
HL7 CDA R2: Consolidated CDA Templates for Clinical Notes (US Realm) DSTU R2.1 (August 2015, June 2019 with Errata)
HL7 CDA R2 IG: C-CDA Templates for Clinical Notes R2.1 Companion Guide, Release 2 (October 2019)
export_components.note: Standard C-CDA; no vendor-specific extensions or customizations documented

export_components.name: FHIR Bulk Data Access
export_components.description: FHIR R4 / US Core STU V3.1.1 bulk data export via (g)(10) SmartOnFHIR API.
export_components.note: Standard US Core resources only; no custom profiles or extensions documented. This is the (g)(10) API repackaged as (b)(10) component.

export_components.name: Patient Demographics & Insurance
export_components.description: Comprehensive view of demographics and insurance details structured for clarity and ease of access.
export_components.note: One-sentence description only. No column names, no field definitions, no sample data.

export_components.name: Appointments
export_components.description: Comprehensive view of all future appointment details, structured for clarity and ease of access.
export_components.note: One-sentence description only. Explicitly says 'future' appointments — historical visit data not mentioned.

export_components.name: Documents
export_components.description: Signed progress notes, available lab results, radiology reports, and any other scanned or uploaded document in the patient's record.
export_components.organizational_structure: Sorted by patient chart number folders with category subfolders (Lab Reports, Radiology, Scanned Receipts, etc.)
export_components.note: Document file export with folder-based organization. No metadata manifest or index file described.
